records.title: Inherit4Rec: Parameter Inheritance for Efficient Scaling of Recommendation Models
records.reason: Inherit4Rec transfers dense-recommender parameters into a sparse MoE to scale recommendation models; full text reports up to 72% lower incremental MoE training cost with small quality changes. Evaluation shares the active shared-plus-top-1 path at inference, but the resource result is training-cost reduction rather than LLM inference/serving improvement. Its linked UniMoMo recommender-acceleration lineage is plausible, but the in-scope runtime connection needs further comparison.
